1.explanation:
1. src/table/selection.jsx – this module injects the select-all column by unconditionally adding a Col with title={this.renderSelectionHeader} and cell={this.renderSelectionBody}. Since the header cell’s content is hard-coded here, you must modify this file to accept a user-provided render function (e.g. rowSelection.headerCell) and fall back to renderSelectionHeader only if none is supplied.

2. src/table/base/header.jsx – this is the core header renderer that takes each column’s title prop (which for the select-all column comes from selection.jsx) and renders it inside a <th>. To properly support a custom header cell callback for the selection column, you may need to adjust how it interprets function-type title or introduce a dedicated cell prop handling for header cells here. Without touching this file, custom header callbacks won’t be invoked, so it also requires updates.
1.bug_scenario: The screenshot shows a Table in selection mode (rowSelection enabled) with a default “select-all” checkbox rendered in the header cell at the very first column. All other columns correctly use the developer’s custom cell renderers (for body) and titles, but the header’s select-all cell is always the built-in Checkbox and can’t be customized by passing a cell or title callback. The issue is that there is no way to override the content of that header checkbox cell when using rowSelection.
